text:
Which statement about the direction of a change of state is correct?
A
Evaporation is the reverse process to boiling.
B
Evaporation is the reverse process to condensation.
C
Evaporation is the reverse process to melting.
D
Evaporation is the reverse process to solidification.

options.label: A
options.text: Evaporation is the reverse process to boiling.

options.label: B
options.text: Evaporation is the reverse process to condensation.

options.label: C
options.text: Evaporation is the reverse process to melting.

options.label: D
options.text: Evaporation is the reverse process to solidification.
